def parse(text):
    parts = text.split(",")
    fields = [part.strip() for part in parts]
    while len(fields) < 3:
        fields.append("")
    return {"name": fields[0], "amount": fields[1], "currency": fields[2]}

import glob,re
api='''def parse_row(text, *, strict=False):
    parts = text.split(",")
    if strict and len(parts) < 3:
        raise ValueError("expected at least three comma-separated fields")
    fields = [part.strip() for part in parts]
    while len(fields) < 3:
        fields.append("")
    return {"name": fields[0], "cents": fields[1], "currency": fields[2]}
'''
open('billing/api.py','w').write(api)
for f in glob.glob('billing/*.py'):
    if f.endswith('api.py') or f.endswith('__init__.py'): continue
    txt=open(f).read()
    new=txt.replace('from .api import parse','from .api import parse_row').replace('= parse(text)','= parse_row(text)').replace('row["amount"]','row["cents"]')
    if new!=txt: open(f,'w').write(new)
print(open('billing/api.py').read())
